articleTitle: This Classic Cartoon Network Show's Movie Finale Is Still Perfect Over 15 Years Later
articleDescription: Over 15 years ago, Cartoon Network aired an official movie finale to their hit series Ed, Edd, n Eddy , and it's still perfect today. Ed, Edd, n' Eddy was a series that delighted many 90s kids when it first premiered. It gained five seasons over ten years of being on the air, and it still holds a place in the hearts of many fans.
